prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `power(matrix, exponent, modulus)` in src/lib.rs for a 2x2 `u64` matrix. Return `matrix^exponent` with every entry reduced modulo `modulus`, or `None` when `modulus == 0`. The zero-th power is the identity. `exponent` may be as large as `10^18`, so use binary exponentiation and `u128` intermediates. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
